query:
MATCH (adr:ArchitectureDecision {enterprise_context: $context})
WHERE adr.decision_area = $area OR adr.title CONTAINS $keyword
RETURN adr.id, adr.title, adr.status, adr.date
ORDER BY adr.date DESC

MATCH (adr:ArchitectureDecision {status: 'implemented', enterprise_context: $context})
OPTIONAL MATCH (adr)-[:APPLIES_TO]->(bc:BoundedContext)
RETURN adr.id, adr.title, adr.decision_area, adr.implementation_date,
       collect(bc.name) AS bounded_contexts
gremlin_query:
g.V().hasLabel('ArchitectureDecision').has('status', 'implemented').has('enterprise_context', context).
  as('adr').
  coalesce(
    out('APPLIES_TO').hasLabel('BoundedContext').values('name').fold(),
    constant([])
  ).as('bounded_contexts').
  select('adr').
  project('adr.id', 'adr.title', 'adr.decision_area', 'adr.implementation_date', 'bounded_contexts').
    by('id').
    by('title').
    by('decision_area').
    by('implementation_date').
    by(select('bounded_contexts'))

query:
MATCH (bc1:BoundedContext {name: $from_bc, enterprise_context: $context})
MATCH (bc2:BoundedContext {name: $to_bc, enterprise_context: $context})
MERGE (bc1)-[r:DEPENDS_ON]->(bc2)
SET r.relationship_type = $relationship_type,
    r.run_id = $run_id
RETURN bc1, r, bc2
gremlin_query:
g.V().hasLabel('BoundedContext').has('name', from_bc).has('enterprise_context', context).as('bc1').
  V().hasLabel('BoundedContext').has('name', to_bc).has('enterprise_context', context).as('bc2').
  coalesce(
    select('bc1').outE('DEPENDS_ON').where(inV().as('bc2')),
    select('bc1').addE('DEPENDS_ON').to(select('bc2'))
  ).property('relationship_type', relationship_type).
    property('run_id', run_id).as('r').
  select('bc1', 'r', 'bc2')

query:
MATCH (bc:BoundedContext {name: $bc_name, enterprise_context: $context})
MERGE (agg:Aggregate {name: $agg_name, enterprise_context: $context})
MERGE (bc)-[r:CONTAINS_AGGREGATE]->(agg)
SET r.run_id = $run_id
RETURN bc, agg
